UC-488.note: Step row of a case-law call (Indian Kanoon), n credits charged (n is never 1; 0 on a success shows nothing). Follows the done or tried line after " " ("Searched case law. · 40 credits"). {n} is the credits the Indian Kanoon server reported for that call in its own result (_meta chat.clauseo/credits, 1 credit = ₹0.10), never worked out from the price list; no report shows the plain line. A folded group shows no sum.

UC-490.note: Step row of a case-law call (Indian Kanoon), refused or failed (isError) with charged 0, shown only when the server's report is present. Follows the done or tried line after " " ("Searched case law. · 40 credits"). The words stand for the charge of 0 the Indian Kanoon server reported for that call in its own result (no {n}; elsewhere {n} is the credits it reported) (_meta chat.clauseo/credits, 1 credit = ₹0.10), never worked out from the price list; no report shows the plain line. A folded group shows no sum.
